name: Suzushiro Takaya
source:
He is the younger brother and is treated like a servant by his sister Yuri.
He has bitter feelings toward older women.
For example, when he sees an erotic woman on Nico Nico, he thinks she's a "bitch" or something awful like that.
He has a high level of ability, but he doesn't realize it because his sister is so talented.
